summary:
Design only. Nothing in /home/user/ux-research-qa-skills was changed; the one scratch script lives in the session scratchpad. The plan has four phases, written as file-level outlines.

K0: remove the optional R4 rung that called a user-installed insane-search. This touches the code (ladder, ledger, cli, verdict, and the robots docstring), the brief schema's engine_opt_in field, every mention in the docs, the R4 tests, and the 'installed separately' notice. Only the 'studied as a reference' credits stay: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, the README credits, and public-page-access.md section 18. A packaging test stops the dependency from coming back. Section 11 of public-page-access.md is reused for the new terms rules, so no other section is renumbered.

K1: add a Korean research pack, organised in the K-skill way (structure only, no text or code copied):
- Seven references under references/research/korea/: overview (when to use it, what changes at each phase, cue words, a 하지 않는 일 list, Done when / Failure modes), platform-map, query-craft, promotion, statistics, legal-checklist, and report-template (written in Korean).
- references/persona-qa/kwcag-2.2.md.
- Two data files. korea-platforms.json covers 27 Korean channels: who posts (as leads, with confidence and sources), voice bias, public scope, legitimate route, expected stops, terms status and platform discontinuities. korea-statistics.json holds provenance-card fields, frames, count-only flags, and agency aliases after the 2025-10-01 renamings.
- A bilingual README: README.ko.md has the same sections as README.md, a language switcher, and a parity test.
- Korean trigger phrases in the SKILL.md description (858 characters, 984 bytes).
- Matching edits to workflow, audience-pipeline, source-grading, research-protocol, evidence-classification, the templates and the bundle contract.

K2: change reader policy.
- New stop class terms_restricted, driven by route-table entries. These are marked 'reported' for DC Inside, Naver Cafe, YouTube pages, Instagram, Threads and Facebook. A reported entry is lifted only when the user records their own terms check; a confirmed entry is never lifted. YouTube is read only through the Data API with the user's key.
- robots.txt groups for AI agents that fetch pages for users are honoured as if they named our own token.
- Search-result pages are refused with exit 2.
- The Naver and Kakao search APIs are switched off until the owner reads the current terms.
- New Korean marker families: KFTC disclosure wordings (split by where they appear in a post), review-event incentives, AI virtual persons, identity and cafe-level gates, and default anonymous nicknames.
- Tests to match.

K3 (planned):
- Researcher notes: the researcher's own reading of pages the pipeline must not read, paraphrased and graded one step lower.
- A scrub command for team VOC and support exports.
- The YouTube API adapter.

The existing evidence rules do not change. Posts support existence only. Sizes need measured or statistical sources with a stated frame. Synthetic personas are never evidence. Anything unverified is marked as such: most platform facts come from search summaries; Naver's 2026 terms, the Naver Cafe notice and the Kakao policies were not read in the original; the AI-agent token names still need checking against each operator's documentation.

files.purpose: Remove the R4 hook. Add the terms_restricted pre-check, official-only mode, search-page refusal, AI-agent robots groups, and position-aware promotion flags.
files.outline:
K0 (remove R4):
- Docstring: drop the R4 lines.
- PRESENTATION = {'R0': 'official_route', 'R1': 'honest_ua', 'R2': 'site_alternate', 'R3': 'real_browser'}.
- Delete _engine_preconditions(), engine_rung(), and the engine_opt_in branch in _remaining().
- Drop 'engine_rung' from read and ingest results, and 'engine_version' from ledger outcome entries.
- Remove 'engine_rung' from __all__.

K2 (reader policy):
- Routes loads two new route-table lists: terms_restricted and search_pages.
- scope_stop() checks in this order: deny_hosts; then search_pages (refuse with exit 2, reason 'search_results_page', no request); then out_of_scope; then terms_restricted; then robots.txt.
- A terms entry stops the URL before any request, including robots.txt. Stop class 'terms_restricted', URL scope, reasons ['terms:<status>:<restricts>', note]. Two exceptions:
  (a) the entry is 'reported' and policy.terms_checked lists the host. The stop is lifted for this run and the lift is recorded in the trail and the ledger.
  (b) the entry names an official route whose kind is implemented and whose key is set. This is official-only mode: R0 runs, R1-R3 are skipped, and an R0 failure ends the URL as terms_restricted with reason 'official_route_failed'.
- A missing key adds reason 'official_route_needs_key:<ENV>'. A route kind with no adapter adds 'official_route_unavailable'. The brief can never lift a 'confirmed' entry.
- check_robots (the robots command) exits 3 for terms_restricted hosts and 2 for search pages, so browser tools never open them.
- The robots decision passes the lists from data/agent-tokens.json to robots.decide(). A disallow in an honoured AI-agent group gives stop opted_out, reason 'robots:ai_agent:<token>'. Disallows aimed at training crawlers go only to result['robots']['ai_signals'].
- Promotion: pass lead = page title + first 150 characters of main text into verdict.promotion_flags(). Add incentive_flags and virtual_person_flags to read and ingest results.
- Every host and token comes from data files. The existing no-site-names contract test keeps applying.

files.purpose: List the robots.txt tokens of other AI agents. The reader honours disallows aimed at agents that fetch for users, and records training-crawler opt-outs as a signal only.
files.outline:
K2. New data file, read by robots.py through ladder.py.

Top level: schema_version 'ux-research-agent-tokens.v1'; version '2026-09-29.1'; verified_at null.
note: 'robots.txt product tokens of other AI agents. A group naming a token in fetch_on_behalf_of_users that disallows the path is honoured as if it named RemorsearchUXQA, because this reader is also an AI agent fetching for a person. Tokens in training_or_index only raise the ai_training_opt_out signal in the access table. Compile each token from its operator's own documentation and record the URL in doc.'

fetch_on_behalf_of_users: [{token, operator, doc: null}]. Candidates: ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User, MistralAI-User, Meta-ExternalFetcher.
training_or_index candidates: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider, Amazonbot.
The candidate names come from general knowledge, not from pages read in this research. Verify each against its operator's page before shipping and drop any that cannot be confirmed.

Why this rule:
- Naver's blog and cafe robots.txt reportedly block AI crawlers since 2025-07 (https://www.etnews.com/20250716000347).
- Coupang's robots.txt reportedly blocks ChatGPT-User (https://www.digitalmarketer.co.kr/insights/coupang-robots-txt-partners-strategy; low).
- PIPC's 2025 generative-AI guide treats a robots.txt block as a clear refusal (read via the extraction https://github.com/lak2211-columbia/project-babel/blob/main/data/parsed/south_korea/kr_genai_personal_data_guide_2025/normalized.txt).

files.purpose: Machine-readable Korean platform map: who posts (as leads), voice bias, public scope, legitimate route, expected stops, terms status and discontinuities. One row per channel, linked to routes.json.
files.outline:
K1. Data file. Read by tests now; by the planned note command and gate later.

Top level: schema_version 'ux-research-korea-platforms.v1'; version '2026-09-29.1'; verified_at null.
note: planning map, not reader policy; audience figures are leads, never segment shares; platform names are descriptive, no affiliation; checked_at comes from search summaries and a few primary files.
vocab:
- family: blog | community | qna | video | app_store_reviews | microblog | commerce_reviews
- public_scope: public | mixed | app_heavy | app_only | private
- route: official_api_user_key | official_feed | team_export | reader_public_page | researcher_note | none
- terms_status: reported | confirmed | checked_by_user | unchecked
- confidence: high | medium | low

Row fields: id, name_ko, hosts, route_ids, family, public_scope, routes (in order of preference), expected_stops, terms {status, restricts, sources, note}, audience {text, confidence, sources}, voice_notes, privacy_notes, discontinuities [{date, what, sources}], checked_at '2026-09-29', verified_at null.

Rows (values to write; none checked live):

1 naver-blog 네이버 블로그. Hosts blog.naver.com, m.blog.naver.com; blog.
- Scope: public (전체공개 only; 이웃공개, 서로이웃공개 and 비공개 are not public).
- Routes: official_feed (RSS, unverified), then reader_public_page, then researcher_note.
- Stops: opted_out expected (AI-crawler robots blocks reported: https://www.etnews.com/20250716000347).
- Terms: unchecked. Naver's terms reportedly bar non-Naver robots from robots.txt-protected databases (https://news.nate.com/view/20241028n06350).
- Audience (medium): 42.29M monthly active users; ages 19-34 are 50% of blog-app users (https://v.daum.net/v/20251222105605977?f=p).
- Voice: 9,423 suspected hidden-ad posts in KFTC 2024 monitoring (https://www.newsis.com/view/NISX20250314_0003098900); Naver requires paid posts to disclose in the title or first part from 2024-12 (https://www.ajunews.com/view/20241115102251443).

2 naver-cafe 네이버 카페 (맘카페 포함). cafe.naver.com, m.cafe.naver.com; community.
- Scope: mixed (public boards, member-only boards, 등업 gates).
- Routes: researcher_note, then an authorised signed-in community.
- Stops: terms_restricted, auth_gate, opted_out.
- Terms: reported (bulk_collection, automated_collection). A notice reported on 2026-08-31 bans bulk collection without member and cafe consent, including by crawlers, bots and scripts (https://www.newsis.com/view/NISX20260831_0003769836, https://v.daum.net/v/20260831151156866). The primary notice was not read.
- Audience (low): cafe app 9.52M monthly users in 2025-02 (Wiseapp estimate: https://www.wiseapp.co.kr/insight/detail/643). That local mom cafes are mostly women in their 30s-40s is an inference (https://www.koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO202126048549439.pdf).
- Voice: hidden marketing and fake reviews reported (https://www.hankyung.com/society/article/2020100565571).
- Privacy: paraphrase only; child, health and neighbourhood details.

3 naver-kin 네이버 지식iN. kin.naver.com, m.kin.naver.com; qna; public.
- Routes: reader_public_page, then researcher_note. Terms: unchecked.

6. Done when: the channels used are listed with route and stop; every host has a terms status; statistics carry cards; each source has a promotion check; lexicon.json is saved; report-check passes on the Korean template.
7. Failure modes:
   - Naver surfaces stop. This is expected; say so, and use notes and team data.
   - Global search under-indexes Naver (unverified); absence of results is not absence of discussion.
   - Community demographics conflict; keep them lead-only.
   - Review bombs.
   - Platform facts older than 90 days; re-check.
   - Terms change after ownership changes (DC Inside 2026; Daum 2025-2026).
8. One line per file in this folder.

Korean query craft and how to read Korean user language: portal operators, seed vocabularies, a dated per-run lexicon, 초성체, 야민정음, slang, anonymous identity, sarcasm, register, evidential endings and Unicode.
files.outline:
K1. English prose, Korean examples.
1. Language policy: Korean first, then the English terms users actually write. Search the brand in 한글, in English and in short forms (카톡, 카뱅, 당근), plus misspellings seen in the corpus.
2. Portals (verify live):
   - Naver operators per user guides are +, -, quotes and | (https://www.clien.net/service/board/lecture/6343874; low).
   - site:, before: and after: are unconfirmed on Naver. Put the year, a version or '업데이트 후' into the query instead.
   - Global web search may under-index Naver (unverified).
   - Result pages are never loaded.
3. Seed families (keep only terms seen in the run):
   - failure: 불편, 오류, 안 됨, 먹통, 튕김, 렉, 무한 로딩, 버벅, 안 눌려요, 씹혀요
   - consequence: 포기, 결국, 다시, 해지, 탈퇴, 환불, 갈아탐, 고객센터, 상담원 연결
   - version: 업데이트 후, 개편, 예전 UI
   - segment: 부모님, 어르신, 엄마, 아이랑, 직장인, 출퇴근, 대학생, 수험생, 자영업, 사장님, 초보, 처음, 노안, 큰 글씨, 색약, 한 손, 운전 중, 지하철
   - Korean flows: 본인인증 안 됨, 휴대폰 인증, 공동인증서, 간편인증, 카톡으로 열면, 인앱 브라우저, 앱 설치 강요
   - counter-search: 편해요, 만족, 문제없음, 잘 돼요, 괜찮아요, 추천해요
4. Run lexicon, lexicon.json {term, variants, meaning with an example source ID, first_seen, channel}:
   - look a word up in 우리말샘 first (https://opendict.korean.go.kr/main);
   - a dictionary entry is neither approval nor frequency (https://www.korean.go.kr/front/reportData/reportDataList.do);
   - a model never asserts a slang meaning without an example from this run.
5. Reading user language:
   - 초성체: keep it raw; expand only with support from the thread; polarity is unknown when the 초성 token carries the claim (https://ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/%EC%B4%88%EC%84%B1%EC%B2%B4).
   - 야민정음 and look-alike spellings (댕댕이, 커여워, 띵곡): count variants as one word; keep the original spelling (https://ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/%EC%95%BC%EB%AF%BC%EC%A0%95%EC%9D%8C).
   - Value slang: 혜자 and 창렬 (https://www.kyeonggi.com/article/201505200651375); 상타치, 하타치, 평타 are never used to guess a poster's politics. Press-sourced.
   - Anonymous identity: 유동, 고정닉, 반고정닉; the default ㅇㅇ counts by thread.
   - Sarcasm: read the parent post and the replies around it. Polarity is uncertain when praise comes with ㅋㅋ or ㅎㅎ, a tilde, an ellipsis, quotation marks, a switch between 존댓말 and 반말, or an outcome that contradicts the praise. Uncertain posts never support satisfaction or a counter-search. These heuristics are unvalidated (context matters: https://aclanthology.org/2024.lrec-main.864/).
   - Register (해요체, 합쇼체, 해체) shows setting and stance, never age or gender (https://www.korean.go.kr/front/onlineQna/onlineQnaView.do?mn_id=&qna_seq=332328&pageIndex=1). 합쇼체 ad copy inside a review is a weak promotion cue.
   - Hearsay endings (~대, ~래, ~라더라, 들었는데, 지인이 그러는데, 카더라) send the post to the verifier. ~더라 is not proof of firsthand use (https://www.kci.go.kr/kciportal/landing/article.kci?arti_id=ART001256271).
   - Unicode: NFC everywhere; extract.py already normalises. Compatibility-jamo runs are tokens. Derive 초성 from NFC text only (https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr15/).
6. Time windows: search before and after redesigns and review bombs.
7. Done when / Failure modes: literal translations; a model-invented meaning; variant spellings counted as extra people; sarcasm read as praise.

files.purpose: Handle promotion and astroturfing in Korean sources under the KFTC guideline and related law, as grading rules and flags.
files.outline:
K1.
1. Context:
   - 체험단 posts, affiliate footers and review events are common; 내돈내산 is a self-declared tag (https://plus.hankyung.com/apps/newsinside.view?aid=202004177508i&category=AA008&sns=y).
   - KFTC monitoring found 25,966 suspected posts in 2023 and 22,011 in 2024 (https://www.newsis.com/view/NISX20250314_0003098900). These are counts, never a prevalence or a denominator.
2. The rule. KFTC 추천·보증 심사지침, 예규 제499호, in force 2026-06-01, read in full through the mirror; official: https://www.law.go.kr/행정규칙/추천ㆍ보증등에관한표시ㆍ광고심사지침.
   - Disclose in every post.
   - Placement: text posts in the title or first part; photos in the image, the first line or the first hashtag; video in the title, or at start and end and repeated.
   - Clear wordings versus unclear ones (체험단, 선물, '~에서 보내주셨어요', and the English labels).
   - Virtual persons must be disclosed (V.5).
   - A testimonial from someone who never used the product is itself an unfair ad.
3. Timeline: 2020-09-01; 2024-12-01; 2025-12 Q&A guide (not read); 2026-06-01 (https://www.korea.kr/briefing/pressReleaseView.do?newsId=156660604).
4. Grading:
   (a) Any disclosure caps the source at D once a verifier confirms it.
   (b) Text only: promo_check text_only. After 2024-12, an empty title and opening count as weaker evidence of no relationship.
   (c) 내돈내산 and 광고 아님 carry no weight.
   (d) Review events cap at D; a seller page announcing rewards flags every review on it; star averages are never satisfaction (KCA 2024: https://www.ddaily.co.kr/m/page/view/2024072313572368748).
   (e) A disclosed virtual person is E.
   (f) A seller's own review board is curated (예규 제272호: https://www.law.go.kr/행정규칙/인터넷광고에관한심사지침; 전자상거래법 제21조의4, in force 2026-07-21).
   (g) Reviews of a platform's own-brand items need another channel family to count (KFTC 2024-284, under litigation).
   (h) Staff or agency posts are concealed interest (예규 제488호).
5. Markers: the families in markers.json; never bare words.
6. Astroturf flags (never accusations):
   - near-identical text;
   - bursts of similar posts;
   - a question and an answer praising the same product in one thread (a pattern sold as 침투 marketing: https://adcorp.kr/pages/services/community.html, a sales page);
   - accounts with a single review;
   - praise with no task detail;
   - 합쇼체 ad copy;
   - identical hashtag sets.
   A flag needs another channel family before it counts. Never name a person as an advertiser (표시광고법 addresses businesses: https://www.law.go.kr/법령/표시ㆍ광고의공정화에관한법률).
7. Done when / Failure modes.

files.purpose: Korean quantitative sources for segment sizing: provenance card, frame rules, sources by audience question, how to get the numbers, and agency renamings.
files.outline:
K1.
1. Scope: statistics bound a population; they never measure the product's users.
2. Provenance card, required and stored as stat_card: publisher as named on the publication date, title, 승인번호, KOSIS orgId/tblId or data.go.kr id, 기준 시점, frame, n and method, weights and error from the 통계설명자료, unit, the value as printed, URL, retrieval date in KST, licence (공공누리 type; unverified).
3. Frame rules:
   - Age frames differ: 3+, 13+, 10-69; '고령층' means 55+ in the digital-divide survey and 65+ in KCA studies. Never add or compare shares across frames; record which threshold a persona uses.
   - Oversampled strata give no population shares from raw n.
   - KCA quota designs (100 per decade) give within-band rates only.
   - count_only data are never denominators.
   - Keep each survey's own definition (KPF recent use against Gallup annual use).
   - Vendors are estimates (C); community demographics from modelled traffic are D.
4. By audience question (registry ids):
   - Segments and weight: team analytics; KOSIS and 주민등록; 인터넷이용실태조사 2025, 95.0% and 44.5% (https://www.korea.kr/briefing/pressReleaseView.do?newsId=156751949).
   - Devices: Gallup 2025 (https://www.gallup.co.kr/gallupdb/reportContent.asp?seqNo=1566); 방송매체 이용행태조사; KOCCA 2025.
   - Conditions: 디지털정보격차 2025, 77.9%. Disability, colour-vision and presbyopia prevalence were not retrieved.
   - Contexts and pains: KCA kiosk 2022 (queue pressure 52.8%; original not read).
   - Channel reach, for planning only: KPF, Gallup Market70, Wiseapp, Reuters.
5. Getting numbers:
   - KOSIS OpenAPI with the user's key (planned; REMORSEARCH_KOSIS_API_KEY). Staged: find the table, read its metadata, pull a slice, then widen. At most 40,000 cells per call. Per-minute limits were announced 2026-07-09 (not read): https://kosis.kr/openapi/
   - data.go.kr: each API needs its own 활용신청 and the user's key (steps unverified).
   - PDFs and spreadsheets: save the text and ingest it.
   - DataLab is off.
   - A missing key is a gap and a question.
6. Renamings on 2025-10-01: 통계청 to 국가데이터처, 방송통신위원회 to 방송미디어통신위원회, 특허청 to 지식재산처 (https://mods.go.kr/). The aliases are in the registry.
7. Still to retrieve: disability counts, CVD and presbyopia prevalence, the older-adult sub-index, sampling errors.
8. Done when / Failure modes.

files.purpose: Korean report skeleton and tone rules: register, labels, glossary, dates, attribution, and a detect-only translationese check.
files.outline:
K1. Written in Korean.

A '작성 규칙' block at the top (not copied into reports):
- 본문은 합니다체로 통일합니다. 표와 근거 줄은 개조식(~함, ~임)으로 씁니다.
- 상태 표시: 관찰됨 / 추론 / 미확인.
- 주장 상태 풀이: supported_high 근거 충분(높음), supported_medium 근거 충분(보통), single_voice 한 사람의 보고, lead_only 단서만 있음, conflicting 서로 어긋남, needs_product_check 제품 확인 필요, stale 이전 버전 근거, unfit 맞지 않는 출처.
- 중단 유형 풀이 (terms_restricted = 약관 제한 포함).
- 날짜: 표는 ISO, 시각은 'KST YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.
- 한 개념에 한 단어: 사용자, 세그먼트, 불편 지점, 대처 방법, 사용 맥락, 과업, 근거, 출처, 주장, 반대 근거 검색, 채널 계열, 연구자 메모, 수집 공백. 통계 원문이 '이용자'를 쓰면 인용할 때만 그대로 씁니다.
- 인용과 귀속: 작성자 이름이나 닉네임을 쓰지 않습니다. '작성자는 ~라고 적었습니다 (작성자 진술, 사실 여부 미확인)'. 사람이나 업체에 대한 주장은 중립적으로 풀어 씁니다.
- 수치에는 n, 모집단, 기준 시점, 출처를 붙입니다. 게시글 수는 비율이 아닙니다. 측정 출처가 없으면 '많은 사용자', '대부분'을 쓰지 않습니다.
- 번역투는 탐지만 합니다 (~에 대해, ~를 통해, ~에 있어서, ~되어지다). 인용문, ID, 숫자, URL, 상태 표시는 절대 고치지 않습니다. 고친 비율이 30%를 넘으면 사람이 검토합니다.

files.purpose: KWCAG 2.2 notes for persona-qa: what the standard is, how it differs from WCAG 2.2, the items persona-qa meets most, Korean flows to test, law cited apart from the standard, and the reporting format.
files.outline:
K1.
1. Identity: KS X OT0003:2022, revised 2022-12-28; 4 principles, 14 guidelines, 33 items. Official copy: https://www.rra.go.kr/ko/reference/kcsList_view.do?nb_seq=5247. The a11ykr online edition (https://a11ykr.github.io/kwcag22/) is unofficial and mis-numbers contrast as 1.4.3 (the correct number is 5.4.3).
2. Not WCAG 2.2 AA. It is built on WCAG 2.1 Level A plus mandatory items. The 9 new items: 6.1.4, 6.4.4, 6.5.1 단일 포인터 입력 지원, 6.5.2 포인터 입력 취소, 6.5.3, 6.5.4 동작기반 작동, 7.2.2 (≈ WCAG 3.2.6), 7.3.3 접근 가능한 인증 (≈ 3.3.8/3.3.9), 7.3.4 반복 입력 정보 (≈ 3.3.7). It has no counterpart for reflow, text spacing, non-text contrast, orientation, status messages, target size or focus not obscured (https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/). Run both rule sets.
3. Items persona-qa meets most:
   - 5.4.3: 4.5:1; 3:1 for large, bold or zoomable text.
   - 6.1.3: a 6.0 mm diagonal plus a 1 px margin; desirable, not required.
   - 6.3.1: no 3-50 flashes per second.
   - 5.4.2 autoplay; 5.4.4 content separation.
   - 6.2.1: extensions with at least 20 s notice.
   - 6.1.1, 6.1.2, 6.4.1-6.4.3, 7.1.1, 7.2.1, 7.3.1, 7.3.2, 8.1.1.
   Copy the other Korean titles from the official text.
4. Korean flows to test:
   - in-app browsers as entry points;
   - 본인인증 popups or app switches (7.2.1). These are stops for an agent on production: use staging with mock verification or mark the step untested;
   - CAPTCHA-only sign-up (7.3.3 is stricter than WCAG 3.3.8 AA);
   - image-only 상세페이지 (5.1.1 and contrast);
   - 인증번호 time limits;
   - kiosks (KS X 9211 unverified).
5. Law is cited apart from the standard: 장애인차별금지법 제21조 and 시행령 제14조 (apps since 2021-07-27); 디지털포용법 제19조 and 제21조 (in force 2026-01-22). Never write 'complies with Korean law'.
6. Context: the 2025 site average was 70.4 (https://m.news.nate.com/view/20260326n41384).
7. Report in two columns (KWCAG item, WCAG SC). Results are coverage, not prevalence.
Includes Done when / Failure modes.

skill_description_changes:
New description, all on one line. It measures 858 characters and 984 UTF-8 bytes, is NFC, and has no ': ', no ' #' and no angle brackets. It fits the 1,024 limit whether a host counts characters or bytes, and stays a valid plain YAML scalar:

Evidence-first UX research and UX QA. Researches what real users say in communities, reviews and support threads, and who the users are, so personas come from evidence; runs persona-driven usability QA on the real web or app screen; checks ergonomics and accessibility (one-handed reach, touch accuracy, colour vision, low vision, timing, KWCAG and WCAG items); then fixes and replays the same scenario with explicit write permission. Reads public pages only and stops at logins, paywalls and CAPTCHAs. Keeps observed facts, inference and synthetic personas separate and reports P0-P3 findings with root causes. Use for UX research, audience research for personas, usability testing, UX QA, accessibility and ergonomics checks and Figma comparison, also in Korean (UX 리서치해줘, 사용자 불만 조사해줘, 후기 반응 정리해줘, 대상 사용자 조사해줘, 페르소나 만들어줘, 사용성 테스트해줘, 접근성 점검해줘, 고치고 다시 확인해줘).

What changed:
- Verbs are third person.
- KWCAG and WCAG are named.
- The public-pages boundary is stated.
- The Korean keyword list becomes eight natural requests in 해줘체. insane-research puts quoted Korean requests in its description; K-skill uses full 해줘체 requests in its when-to-use sections.
- 'persona testing' was dropped to stay under the byte limit. 'persona-driven usability QA' and '페르소나 만들어줘' still cover it.

Not used: Claude Code's when_to_use field, and Korean text in agents/openai.yaml. Codex's handling of extra fields and of non-ASCII descriptions is unverified; test on a real install first.
